class.name: SteamWorkshopItem
class.brief_description: A Steam Workshop item returned by a Workshop query.
class.description: Returned in the [code]items[/code] of [signal Steam.workshop_query_completed]. The fields reflect the item at query time; [method get_state], [method is_subscribed], [method is_installed], [method needs_update] and [method get_install_folder] read the current local state from the Steam client.

method.name: are_tags_truncated
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the item has more tags than fit in [method get_tags].

method.name: get_additional_previews
method.description: Returns the item's additional previews as an [Array] of [Dictionary] with the keys [code]url_or_video_id[/code], [code]original_file_name[/code] and [code]type[/code] (a [enum Steam.WorkshopPreviewType] value). Only set when the query used the [code]return_additional_previews[/code] option.

method.name: get_children
method.description: Returns the published file IDs of the item's children. Only set when the query used the [code]return_children[/code] option.

method.name: get_consumer_app_id
method.description: Returns the ID of the app that consumes the item.

method.name: get_creator_app_id
method.description: Returns the ID of the app that created the item.

method.name: get_description
method.description: Returns the item's description. It is truncated unless the query used the [code]return_long_description[/code] option.

method.name: get_file_name
method.description: Returns the cloud file name of the item's primary file (legacy items only).

method.name: get_file_size
method.description: Returns the size of the item's primary file in bytes. May be inaccurate for items larger than 4 GB; prefer [method get_total_files_size].

method.name: get_file_type
method.description: Returns the item's [enum Steam.WorkshopFileType].

method.name: get_install_folder
method.description: Returns the absolute path of the item's installed content, or an empty [String] if it is not installed.

method.name: get_key_value_tags
method.description: Returns the item's key-value tags as a [Dictionary] mapping each key to a [PackedStringArray] of values. Only set when the query used the [code]return_key_value_tags[/code] option.

method.name: get_metadata
method.description: Returns the item's developer metadata. Only set when the query used the [code]return_metadata[/code] option.

method.name: get_num_children
method.description: Returns the number of child items (for collections).

method.name: get_owner_steam_id
method.description: Returns the Steam ID of the item's creator.

method.name: get_preview_file_size
method.description: Returns the size of the item's preview file in bytes.

method.name: get_preview_url
method.description: Returns the URL of the item's main preview image. Download it with [HTTPRequest] to display it.

method.name: get_published_file_id
method.description: Returns the item's unique published file ID.

method.name: get_result
method.description: Returns the Steam [code]EResult[/code] code for this item in the query ([code]1[/code] means success).

method.name: get_score
method.description: Returns the item's calculated vote score, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns the item's current local state as [enum Steam.WorkshopItemState] flags. See [method Steam.get_item_state].

method.name: get_statistics
method.description: Returns the item's statistics returned by Steam, such as [code]num_subscriptions[/code], [code]num_favorites[/code], [code]num_unique_subscriptions[/code], [code]num_seconds_played[/code] and [code]num_comments[/code].

method.name: get_tags
method.description: Returns the item's tags.

method.name: get_time_added_to_user_list
method.description: Returns when the item was added to the queried user list, as a Unix timestamp. Only set by [method Steam.query_user_workshop_items].

method.name: get_time_created
method.description: Returns when the item was created, as a Unix timestamp.

method.name: get_time_updated
method.description: Returns when the item was last updated, as a Unix timestamp.

method.name: get_title
method.description: Returns the item's title.

method.name: get_total_files_size
method.description: Returns the total size of all of the item's files in bytes, excluding the preview file.

method.name: get_url
method.description: Returns the URL associated with the item (for video or website items).

method.name: get_visibility
method.description: Returns the item's [enum Steam.WorkshopVisibility].

method.name: get_votes_down
method.description: Returns the number of down votes.

method.name: get_votes_up
method.description: Returns the number of up votes.

method.name: has_tag
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the item has the given tag. The comparison is case-insensitive.

method.name: is_accepted_for_use
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the developer flagged the item as accepted in the Workshop.

method.name: is_banned
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the item was banned.

method.name: is_installed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the item is currently installed.

method.name: is_subscribed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the local user is currently subscribed to the item.

method.name: needs_update
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the item needs to be downloaded or updated.
